theorem_summary: Let H be independent of two independent R^3 banks A,B, put (L,V,P)=A+B, let ||f_H||inf<=m and K=K2+K3 be the two-bank marginal/joint density currency. For Q=2HL+2bLP+V^2+alpha L^2+beta L+gamma0 with b!=0, every interval I obeys P(Q in I)<=|I| inf_{0<R<=1}[A_b sqrt(R)+m/(2R)], A_b=C_T(1+sqrt(2))K|b|^(-1/2)/4. Hence ||p_Q||inf,ess <= (3/2)m^(1/3)max(m,A_b)^(2/3), with the active branch O(m^(1/3)K^(2/3)|b|^(-1/3)). The estimate remains valid for lambda(V+sL+v0)^2, |lambda|>=1. No moments/support/post-rotation independence/fiber supremum.
endpoint_summary: At b=0, the prior QFORM-NULL-HUB-TRANSVERSE-SQUARE-v1 theorem applies to the total (L,V) convolution density, so the exact endpoint is uniformly bounded.
